auth.note: Ollama's docs use a placeholder key and say the server ignores it.

verified.notes: Exercised on Windows 11 with Ollama 0.40.17 (ollama serve from the release zip): it listened on 11434, and /api/ps and /v1/models answered lists, empty ones before any model existed, so detection named Ollama. With an imported model, /api/ps marked it loaded after the first request. Through ezbx gateway serve on the host (with a placeholder key): the model list, a chat, a streamed chat ending in [DONE], /v1/messages and /v1/responses all answered. POST /api/generate with keep_alive 0 unloaded it (done_reason unload) and /api/ps was empty again. Not yet checked from a box through Docker Desktop's host alias.
